description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for git worktree listing functionality, testing various scenarios such as listing all worktrees, porcelain output, locked worktrees, prunable annotations, bare repositories, and error conditions.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, running the provided commands.

methods.name: test_config
methods.description: Configures git settings for the test scenario.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test completes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output, failing if they differ.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in input, failing if not found.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of test script.

methods.name: test_tool
methods.description: Access to test helper tools (likely implementation-specific).

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Utility to advance the test timestamp.
